corrective_action: Develop standardized operator-level energy-efficiency indicators and reporting requirements
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: No common numerical operator-level energy-performance target or standardized measurement method is currently available

corrective_action: Adopt a common reporting format for energy consumption energy savings fuel use and efficiency indicators across operators
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(a)
evidence_basis: Operators report energy-efficiency performance using different indicators and levels of quantitative detail

corrective_action: Standardize reporting of renewable-energy capacity generation consumption share sites and procurement separately
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Sections 5.1.3-5.1.4
evidence_basis: Operators use different renewable-energy indicators and units such as sites capacity energy generation percentage and EACs

corrective_action: Address technical procurement and contractual barriers affecting renewable-energy procurement and CPPA implementation
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(b)
evidence_basis: Large-scale renewable procurement depends on CPPA arrangements and some procurement status remains pending or unresolved
responsible_actor: Mobile operators and relevant energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Require consistent disclosure of Scope 1 Scope 2 and where applicable Scope 3 emissions using defined reporting boundaries and methodologies
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Operator-level GHG data and reduction targets are not sufficiently disclosed for all operators

corrective_action: Establish common GHG reporting boundaries baselines units and calculation methodologies for operator-level comparison
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Operators report emissions reductions using different baselines measures and reporting formats

corrective_action: Require operators to monitor progress against their own disclosed GHG reduction targets and report annual progress
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(d)
evidence_basis: Available evidence shows differences between operator-level emissions performance and stated reduction objectives

corrective_action: Require operator-level reporting of telecom e-waste generated collected reused recycled and disposed with defined reporting categories
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c); Renewable Energy Policy 2025 Section 14.3
evidence_basis: Quantitative operator-level e-waste data is not sufficiently disclosed for some operators

corrective_action: Develop standardized telecom e-waste reporting categories units and reporting boundaries across operators
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.11(c)
evidence_basis: Available e-waste information differs in quantity scope and classification across operators

corrective_action: Establish reporting of infrastructure-sharing arrangements coverage shared facilities and measurable environmental or energy benefits
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clauses 5.3 7.2.8 7.7 and 13.6
evidence_basis: Operators do not provide sufficient quantitative evidence to measure the extent or environmental benefits of infrastructure sharing

corrective_action: Establish standardized reporting of tower fiberization progress against applicable policy milestones
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.5
evidence_basis: Insufficient operator-level evidence is available to assess progress against fiberization milestones

corrective_action: Strengthen regulatory facilitation incentives and implementation support for renewable-energy procurement and deployment
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.12; Clause 11.11(b)
evidence_basis: Renewable procurement and implementation challenges indicate a need for supporting mechanisms and coordination
responsible_actor: BTRC government and relevant energy-sector authorities

corrective_action: Review the balance between network-resilience requirements and opportunities for lower-emission backup power solutions in disaster-prone sites
policy_basis: BTRC Telecommunications Network and Licensing Policy 2025 Clause 11.2.7
evidence_basis: Diesel generators are required at a defined share of tower sites in disaster-prone areas while the policy also promotes lower-emission technologies
